passed.criterion: the review route is accept, which the cascade guarantees only for a decision score at or above DEFAULT_MIN_SCORE (0.85)
passed.failed_note: every one of the nine carries a decision score mapped just below the acceptance floor, so each is a refinement decision rather than a graded near miss

review_scores.rule: Medians are compared only over names whose new score is graded and whose earlier score exists, because a decision recorded at the acceptance floor and a graded score are not the same measure.
review_scores.why: The fifteen written names were reviewed by the Jev-deciding cascade: six returned a graded decision above the floor and nine returned a refinement decision recorded at it. The earlier scores are graded quorum means from the documentation reviewer chain. The nine floor decisions carry no grade, so they are excluded from the comparison rather than blended into it.

cost.note: The written figure covers documentation writing only; a published llm_cost covers name generation, documentation and its review together, and llm_cost_review_docs covers documentation review. Writing one family member costs USD 0.0117 against a published all-axis median of USD 0.152 per name and a published documentation-review median of USD 0.0733.

limits: The review ran on a disposable graph carrying only the fifteen names, so it had none of the graph-derived context a live review receives: no Data Dictionary source context, no scored review examples and no catalog neighbours. The nine refinement decisions are therefore a lower bound under degraded context, not a measure of the documentation.

The two regimes differ in kind: the written scores are Jev-deciding decisions, the earlier scores are quorum means from the reviewer chain. Only the six graded written scores are compared, and even those were decided by one judgment rather than a quorum.
The writer run reported twelve of the fifteen names present in the published catalog; the other three were seeded from the name alone, so their descriptions are not the catalog's.

review_arms.how: A disposable Neo4j was seeded read-only from the project graph with the catalog slice the documentation review reads: 5,497 StandardName rows (description, documentation, kind, unit, physics_domain, physical_base, source_paths, stage, reviewer_score, reviewer_score_docs, review_mean_score, documentation_score, origin), 10,158 StandardNameSource rows and 6,733 PRODUCED_NAME edges. Two review arms then ran in that one instance under the same route (process_review_docs_batch): the fifteen definitions this change rendered, and the fifteen definitions the catalog publishes for the same names. The project graph was not written.
context_missing: No IMASNode rows were copied: none of the fifteen rows carries source_paths, so there was no DD path to copy and the DD path context is absent from both arms.
The DD resolution manifest nodes were absent, so the reviewer's source-grounding read reported "DD source text unavailable" on two names in the rendered arm.
No vector index exists on a disposable instance, so vector neighbours were empty in both arms; same-base and same-path neighbours were served by the copied catalog.
Scored review examples were served from the copied catalog, which carries reviewer_score, reviewer_score_docs and physics_domain.

shortfall.rule: The rendered arm passes 6 names and the published control passes 11, so the rendered arm does not pass at least as many. Every shortfall is listed with the review's stated reason below.

A reason naming the rendered shared sentence is a defect of this change; one about the name-specific text is not.
grouping.finding: None of the nine names the rendered shared sentence. The review returns numeric dimension scores rather than prose: physics_accuracy is 0.6 to 4.1 on the six species densities, completeness 2.6 to 6.2, while documentation_quality stays at 11.5 to 17.0. Two names also carry a documentation_contradiction hold whose stated reason is "DD source text unavailable", which is a limit of this context build rather than a finding about the definition.
grouping.caveat: A numeric dimension score neither names the shared sentence nor clears it. The six shortfalls are exactly the six species densities, and the population sentence is the only text this change added to them, so the shortfall is consistent with that sentence being judged a physics inaccuracy. The record states that as an inference from which names moved, not as something the review said.
